design: Matched H601 held-out item IDs4-7 only, all five tasks. Cross old/new wording with original nuisance edit versus For the record prefix. Preserve lexical content of original edit in both wordings. Template=2*wording+edit_type. Freeze H601 broad64 basis and number/multi metrics. Three equal-norm signals, both signs. No fitting or competence filtering.
gate: Per task/template >=4 pairs, >=.75 both-endpoint candidate correctness and >=.5 intended-group full-vocab top1. Nuisance competence separately reported.
scope: Matched familiar/fresh conditions, adaptive factorial; no global novelty claim. Same-answer context changes differ by task and are not proven semantically inert. Equal Attention5 norms do not imply equal downstream e. One random direction only. Single-token CE uses explicit intended answer, group NLL separately. No full-model or canonical uniqueness claim.
